data.name: Saeqa
data.gender_notes: Saeqa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word ‘Saqa’ meaning ‘thunderbolt’. This name symbolizes the gentle yet powerful force of nature. The name Saeqa carries the meaning “Thunderbolt” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Saeqa usually hope their child will grow to embody thunderbolt and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Inspires the courage to overcome challenges and difficulties, while maintaining a gentle and compassionate demeanor.
data.etymology: Saeqa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Thunderbolt.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Saeqa total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: سعقة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يدل على السرعة و الاندفاع نحو الخير أو الشر
in_arabic.long_meaning: سعقة هو اسم عربي يدل على السرعة و الاندفاع نحو الخير أو الشر، و هو مشتق من الفعل سَعَقَ الذي يعني الإسراع أو الاندفاع. و في القرآن الكريم، يوصف الله سبحانه و تعالى بأنه سريع في مغفرته و رحمته. و يعتبر اسم سعقة من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني السرعة و الإسراع في العمل الصالح.

in_urdu.name: سعقہ
in_urdu.meaning: یہ نام حسن و خوبی کی سرعت اور اندفاع کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: سعقہ ایک عربی نام ہے جو حسن و خوبی کی سرعت اور اندفاع کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام عربی زبان کے الفعل سَعَقَ سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے جلدی کرنا یا اندفاع کرنا۔ اسلامی تقویم میں، یہ نام ان معانی کے حامل ہیں جو حسن و خوبی کی سرعت اور اندفاع کو ظاہر کرتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: सअक़ा
in_hindi.meaning: यह नाम अच्छे कामों में तेजी और उत्साह की ओर संकेत करता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: सअक़ा एक अरबी नाम है जो अच्छे कामों में तेजी और उत्साह की ओर संकेत करता है। यह नाम अरबी भाषा के क्रिया सअक़ से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है जल्दी करना या उत्तेजित होना। इस्लामी परंपरा में, यह नाम अच्छे कामों में तेजी और उत्साह के अर्थों को प्रकट करता है।

in_pashto.name: سعقه
in_pashto.meaning: دا نوم د ښو کارونو د چټکتیا او هڅې په ګوته کوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: سعقه د عربي نوم دی چې د ښو کارونو د چټکتیا او هڅې په ګوته کوي. دا نوم د عربي ژبې د فعل سَعَقَ څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې معنی یې ده ژر تر ژره کول یا هڅول. په اسلامي دود کې، دا نوم د ښو کارونو د چټکتیا او هڅې معانی څرګندوي.

in_english.name: Saeqa
in_english.meaning: This name signifies swiftness and eagerness towards good or evil
in_english.long_meaning: Saeqa is an Arabic name that signifies swiftness and eagerness towards good or evil. It is derived from the Arabic verb سَعَقَ (sa'aka), which means to hasten or rush. In the Quran, Allah is described as swift in His forgiveness and mercy. The name Saeqa carries connotations of speed and swiftness in performing good deeds.

data.cultural_impact: The Islamic name Saeqa carries a significant cultural impact as it is a reminder of the awe-inspiring power of nature. Thunder and lightning represent force and energy, epitomizing the raw and primal aspects of the natural world. Naming a child Saeqa symbolically connects them to the beauty and majesty of creation and inspires a sense of reverence for its power.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Saeqa represents the idea of hidden potential and untapped strength. Like a thunderstorm brewing before it unleashes its power, the name Saeqa serves as a reminder that each individual possesses immense inner power and resilience. It inspires individuals to harness their strengths and face challenges bravely, just as a thunderbolt strikes with force and certainty. The name also highlights the importance of acknowledging and respecting the hidden forces and mysteries of the universe.
